languageModelTools.name: todoforge_listTodos
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists TODO-style comments (TODO, FIXME, HACK, BUG, XXX, NOTE, REVIEW, OPTIMIZE, UNDONE, custom tags), Markdown checklist items and .NET code markers (NotImplementedException, [Obsolete], #warning) that TodoForge has already indexed in the open workspace. Read-only and local. Use it to answer questions like 'what TODOs are overdue', 'what FIXMEs are in src/api', 'what is assigned to me', 'what TODOs did I add on this branch'. Each result has ref (path:line), tag, text, file, 1-based line and, when known, owner, due (YYYY-MM-DD), dueIn (days, negative = overdue), priority, labels, git author and age, change (uncommitted or branch) and pinned. Combine filters; all are optional. Muted TODOs are never returned. Results are limited; narrow filters instead of raising the limit when possible.

file.description: Only TODOs whose workspace-relative path contains this text, for example 'src/api' or 'OrdersController.cs'.

tags.description: Only these tags, for example ['FIXME','BUG']. Case-sensitive as configured.

owner.description: Inline owner from TODO(owner) or git blame author, for example 'ayse'.

status.description: overdue: due date passed. due: has a due date. dueSoon: due within 7 days. stale: older than the user's stale threshold by git blame. mine: owned or written by the current user. new: uncommitted or added on this branch. uncommitted: not committed yet. branch: committed on this branch but not on the base branch.

text.description: Words that must appear in the tag, text, path, owner or labels.

query.description: Optional raw TodoForge filter query, for example 'tag:FIXME @onur -test'. Combined with the other filters.

sortBy.description: Sort order. Defaults to due date when filtering by due status, otherwise file and line.

languageModelTools.name: todoforge_listChanges
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists the TODO-style comments the user is adding: 'uncommitted' (in unsaved or uncommitted changes) and 'branch' (committed on the current branch since it left the base branch). Use it before a commit or pull request, or when the user asks which TODOs they introduced. Read-only, uses only local git data TodoForge already computed; nothing is fetched. Returns the base branch and records with ref, tag, text, file, 1-based line, change and metadata.

scope.description: Which TODOs to list. Default all.

languageModelTools.name: todoforge_getTodo
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns details for one TODO identified by ref ('path:line' as returned by todoforge_listTodos) or by file and 1-based line (the nearest TODO within 3 lines). Includes the full comment text, inline metadata, git blame author, date and commit summary, change status and pin state. Does not return surrounding code; read the file with your own tools if needed.

file.description: Workspace-relative path or file name, used with line when ref is not given.
